WoW: Forever

Combat Rogue

Sustained weapon damage with recurring burst windows, and the only Rogue cleave in the game. Two buttons while levelling.

WoW: Forever · Melee DPS · Updated November 3, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70707 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta closed on October 23 at level 30, so nothing above 30 was tested by players; talents and spells past 30 come from the launch client and Blizzard's posts. Talent rows unlock at levels 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 and 40. Every tree now carries a new single-point milestone talent at 16 points, alongside the familiar ones at 11, 21 and 31. Blizzard's November 2 notes rebuilt the tree's lower rows; Wowhead's two level 20 builds still fit it under the new talent names, and no source has posted a level 30 build, so the level 30 line below extends the Dagger Build on the tree's own point costs. If a tooltip on this page differs from the text, go by the text.

What Combat is for

RiposteRiposteTalentCastInstantCost10 EnergyRangeMeleeCooldown6 sec cooldownDuration6 sec lands at exactly level 20: 10 energy after a parry for 150% weapon damage and a 6-second disarm, on a 6-second cooldown. Every button the level-20 rotation uses is a trained ability rather than a talent. Blade FlurryBlade FlurryLevel 1 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost25 EnergyCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration15 secIncreases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec. at 30 adds the cleave: 25 energy for +20% melee speed and one extra nearby target for 15 seconds, on a 2-minute cooldown.

Icy Veins and Wowhead both land on Combat; ClassicWoW.gg does not score the specs. Icy Veins rates it 4 out of 5 for levelling, 3.0 Overall, tied with Assassination on both scores: "an incredibly simple class to play and to optimize damage. Your rotation will consist primarily of two buttons, Sinister StrikeSinister StrikeLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost45 EnergyRangeMeleeAn instant strike that causes 3 damage in addition to your normal weapon damage. Awards 1 combo point. and EviscerateEviscerateLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 9CastInstantCost35 EnergyRangeMeleeFinishing move that causes damage per combo point, increased by Attack Power: 1 point : 6-10 damage 2 points: 11-15 damage 3 points: 16-20 damage 4 points: 21-25 damage 5 points: 26-30 damage." It adds: "Combat is likely going to continue being an amazing spec for leveling and endgame PvE content." Wowhead agrees from the other direction, calling Combat "probably the most 'complete' Rogue specialization at level 20," with all three of its main abilities already trained. Assassination and Subtlety each miss their signature kit.

Blizzard's own framing is "hard hitting direct damage and little bit of cleave damage with Blade Flurry". AggressionAggressionTalentCastInstantIncreases the damage of your Sinister Strike, Backstab, and Eviscerate abilities by 2%. raises Sinister StrikeSinister StrikeLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost45 EnergyRangeMeleeAn instant strike that causes 3 damage in addition to your normal weapon damage. Awards 1 combo point. and EviscerateEviscerateLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 9CastInstantCost35 EnergyRangeMeleeFinishing move that causes damage per combo point, increased by Attack Power: 1 point : 6-10 damage 2 points: 11-15 damage 3 points: 16-20 damage 4 points: 21-25 damage 5 points: 26-30 damage damage by 5% per rank, 15% at 3/3, and Flash of Steel in row 6 makes ShankShankTalentCastInstantRangeMeleeInflicts normal damage plus 10 to an enemy when attacking from behind., trained at 24, cheaper to press and richer in Energy.

No published build spends a point on defence. Icy Veins states outright "we have made to ignore talents that offer us more defensive stats, specifically Dodge and Parry", judging them unnecessary at this level bracket. RiposteRiposteTalentCastInstantCost10 EnergyRangeMeleeCooldown6 sec cooldownDuration6 sec itself is real, but no source among our three publishes a defensive "Riposte build" at level 20.

Rotation

At level 20 all three Rogue specs play the same. Icy Veins says so on its Assassination page. Wowhead's own three level-20 guides confirm it by being largely interchangeable: "During the early stages of Rogue leveling, it is difficult to really differentiate the specializations."

  1. From 20, Instant PoisonInstant PoisonItem on both weapons
  2. Open from StealthStealthLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCooldown10 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledAllows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 50%. Lasts until cancelled. with AmbushAmbushLevel 18 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost60 EnergyRangeMeleeAmbush the target, causing 250% weapon damage plus 70 to the target.   3. BackstabBackstabLevel 4 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 9CastInstantCost60 EnergyRangeMeleeBackstab the target, causing 150% weapon damage plus 10 to the target. Must be behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point. if you are behind the target with a dagger in the main hand, otherwise Sinister StrikeSinister StrikeLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost45 EnergyRangeMeleeAn instant strike that causes 3 damage in addition to your normal weapon damage. Awards 1 combo point.
  4. At 5 combo points, Slice and DiceSlice and DiceLevel 10 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 2CastInstantCost25 EnergyRange100 yd rangeDuration6 secFinishing move that increases melee attack speed by 20%. Lasts longer per combo point: 1 point : 9 seconds 2 points: 12 seconds 3 points: 15 seconds 4 points: 18 seconds 5 points: 21 seconds if the target will survive its duration

Otherwise EviscerateEviscerateLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 9CastInstantCost35 EnergyRangeMeleeFinishing move that causes damage per combo point, increased by Attack Power: 1 point : 6-10 damage 2 points: 11-15 damage 3 points: 16-20 damage 4 points: 21-25 damage 5 points: 26-30 damage at 5 combo points

Multi-target: nothing until Blade FlurryBlade FlurryLevel 1 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost25 EnergyCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration15 secIncreases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec. is reachable. It costs 25 energy for +20% melee speed and one extra nearby target for 15 seconds, on a 2-minute cooldown. Stat priority

Weapon damage, then Hit and Expertise, Agility, critical strike, Strength, Stamina.

Published gear advice adds: slow main hand, fast off hand, and "Intellect and Spirit are wasted on a rogue."

What Forever changed for Rogues

  • Poisons and Lockpicking are now secondary skills: "like First Aid", not Rogue class skills. Poison numbers are lower with more charges: Instant PoisonInstant PoisonItem rank 1 is "13 to 17 instead of 19 to 25, 60 instead of 40" charges, and Blizzard adds 1% of your Attack Power to it. Poison and a sharpening stone now stack.
  • Rogues can learn axes. The skill starts at 1, so a new axe will miss constantly until you raise it.
  • Sword specialisation went into Hack and SlashHack and SlashTalentCastInstantGives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon. Axe/Sword: Your successful melee attacks have a 5% chance to trigger an extra attack on the target. Dagger/Fist: Increases your critical strike chance by 5%. Mace: Your attacks ignore 15% of your target's armor. too, which is one more than the guide sites print: one still describes the tree as trading "the dagger, fist and mace specializations". Where Blizzard has published an official class deep dive, that post outranks all three and the page is written from it. Everything else — talent ranks, tooltip values, what exists in the tree at all — is settled against the client itself, read through foreverchanges.pro and wago.tools.
